name: NANOS 53rd Annual Meeting 2027
description: The NANOS Annual Meeting is the principal scientific meeting of the North American Neuro-Ophthalmology Society. The 53rd edition is scheduled for San Diego, California.

sources.note: Confirms 2027 dates, city and venue, and notes early-bird registration is expected to open fall 2026 without a specific date

notes: No specific abstract submission or registration deadline dates were published on the official site at time of research; only a note that early-bird registration would open in fall 2026.
